cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check the restore didn't work
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/swarm/services/ 2>&1")
print("Services:", stdout.read().decode())
# Manual fix
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("mv /opt/areloria/server/src/systems/LegendPropagationSystem.ts.skip /opt/areloria/server/src/systems/LegendPropagationSystem.ts 2>&1 || echo already exists")
print("\nLegendProp wiederhergestellt:", stdout.read().decode())
# Try to restore other files
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/server/src/systems/ 2>&1 | grep -E '\\.ts$'")
print("\nSysteme:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
